description: Sigma Operation Registry — all valid CLI operations with pre/post conditions, gating, and outputs. Phase 3 CLI implementation must conform to every entry in this registry.

level_definitions.semantic: Mutates project artifacts or runtime state (progress-v<N>.json, Sigma/ files).
level_definitions.read_only: Reads existing state only — no writes to progress-v<N>.json or artifact files.

role_definitions.any: Any user may invoke this operation.
role_definitions.director: Director-only. CLI enforces this by convention — Sigma has no auth layer; governance relies on role discipline.

operations.description: Create a DIR-CLOSE DRAFT from the template. Gate 3 chain: (1) active INTENT is RATIFIED; (2) at least one PLAN is LOCKED; (3) that PLAN's intent_version_ref points to the active LOCKED INTENT; (4) at least one EXEC is LOCKED; (5) that EXEC's plan_version_ref points to the qualifying PLAN. If the qualifying chain has stale_intent = true, CLI blocks — Director must pass --ack-stale-intent to proceed. Acknowledgment is recorded in the DIR-CLOSE DRAFT metadata. Sets lifecycle_state to CLOSE.

inputs.description: Required (and only accepted) when the qualifying INTENT→PLAN→EXEC chain has stale_intent = true. Acknowledges stale chain and records it in DIR-CLOSE DRAFT metadata.

operations.description: Promote a pending plan into the official draft queue with an assigned version (PLAN-IMPL-MULTIDRAFT-LOCK, Director directive 2026-08-12 — no longer FIFO; see plan_lock). Stage title/focus are written into the chain ROADMAP Stage Overview data.

inputs.name: --id
inputs.description: Pending plan ID to promote (e.g. a3b9)

inputs.name: --title
inputs.description: Stage title written into the ROADMAP Stage Overview table

inputs.name: --focus
inputs.description: Stage focus summary written into the ROADMAP Stage Overview table

outputs.description: Pending plan assigned a version and moved into the official draft queue; ROADMAP stage row recorded

constraints.condition: pending plan with the given ID must exist
constraints.error_message: Pending plan not found

constraints.condition: Gate 1.5 — the chain's ROADMAP must exist and not be SUPERSEDED
constraints.error_message: Gate 1.5 blocked: A ROADMAP must exist for this chain to promote a plan.

gating.pre_condition: pending plan exists; chain ROADMAP exists (Gate 1.5)
gating.post_condition: plan is an official DRAFT, targetable by version via plan_lock's --v

operations.description: Regenerate the derived Stage Overview table in the active chain's ROADMAP document from chain state. The table has no independent data copy, so this cannot drift — it is a pure re-render.

constraints.condition: the chain's ROADMAP must exist
constraints.error_message: No ROADMAP found for this chain. Run: sigma roadmap new

gating.post_condition: Stage Overview table matches chain state exactly

operations.description: Send a message from one role to another. Message files are CLI-generated — never create or rename them manually. Unread gate: the SENDER must have no unread messages in their own inbox before sending (clear with sigma inbox read <id>).

inputs.name: --from
inputs.description: Sender role (arc|fmn|dev|aud)

inputs.name: --to
inputs.description: Recipient role (arc|fmn|dev|aud)

inputs.name: --type
inputs.description: Message type (default: note)

inputs.name: --subject
inputs.description: Short subject line

inputs.name: --message
inputs.description: Message body (single-line; use --message-file for multi-line content)

inputs.name: --message-file
inputs.description: Path to a file whose contents become the message body (preserves newlines)

inputs.name: --attach
inputs.description: File to attach (copied into Sigma/messages/attachments/)

inputs.name: --reply-to
inputs.description: Message ID this message is responding to (soft-check; does not block if not found)

inputs.name: --action
inputs.description: Action required from recipient (default: fyi)

inputs.name: --related-artifact
inputs.description: Artifact this message relates to (e.g. FMN-PLAN-v2, DEV-EXEC-v1; default: N/A)

outputs.description: Message file created in Sigma/messages/{RECIPIENT}/ and registered in Sigma/messages/index.json; attachment copied when provided

constraints.condition: sender must have zero unread messages in their own inbox
constraints.error_message: Send blocked: sender has unread messages. Clear with: sigma inbox read <id>

constraints.condition: --from and --to must be valid messaging roles
constraints.error_message: Valid messaging roles: arc|fmn|dev|aud (director communicates directly)

gating.pre_condition: sender inbox has no unread messages
gating.post_condition: message is unread in the recipient inbox; progress-v<N>.json untouched

operations.description: Diagnose and reconcile Sigma runtime state. Default (or --recovery) reconciles the active chain file against artifacts on disk; --reconstruct rebuilds a missing/corrupted progress-v<N>.json from artifact files; --all-versions applies to every chain.

inputs.name: --recovery
inputs.description: Explicit alias for the default reconciliation behavior

inputs.name: --all-versions
inputs.description: Apply to every chain found on disk instead of just the active one

inputs.name: --reconstruct
inputs.description: Rebuild chain file(s) from artifact files on disk

inputs.name: --v
inputs.description: With --reconstruct, target one specific chain instead of the active one (e.g. v2)

outputs.description: Diagnosis report; progress-v<N>.json repaired or reconstructed when drift/corruption is found

constraints.condition: --v is only meaningful together with --reconstruct
constraints.error_message: --v requires --reconstruct

gating.pre_condition: project root with Sigma/ directory exists
gating.post_condition: chain file(s) consistent with artifacts on disk

operations.description: Validate a DEV-EXEC document structure and markers, and report Lock readiness for `sigma exec lock`. Read-only — never mutates state. Falls back to the active pointer only while unambiguous (0 or 1 DRAFT open); refuses without --v once more than one DRAFT exec is open (PLAN-IMPL-MULTIDRAFT-LOCK §8.3, Director directive 2026-08-12 — no command may act on an implicit target under ambiguity, including read-only ones).

inputs.name: --v
inputs.description: Check a specific DEV-EXEC version. Required when more than one DRAFT exec is open.

outputs.description: Validation report and Lock readiness verdict for DEV-EXEC

constraints.condition: target exec version and its document must exist
constraints.error_message: No DEV-EXEC found. Run: sigma exec new

operations.description: Validate a DIR-INTENT document structure and markers, and report Lock readiness (Eligible / Eligible with warnings / Not eligible) for `sigma intent ratify`. Read-only — never mutates state.

operations.description: Explicitly supersede a RATIFIED DIR-INTENT chain. Cascades SUPERSEDED to the chain's ROADMAP, FMN-PLAN, DEV-EXEC, and DIR-CLOSE artifacts. Requires --director-confirm — this is a Director-authority irreversible governance action.

inputs.name: --v
inputs.description: Chain version to supersede (e.g. v1) — need not be the active chain

inputs.name: --reason
inputs.description: Reason for superseding

inputs.name: --director-confirm
inputs.description: Explicit Director authorization to execute the supersede

outputs.description: Chain intent.state = SUPERSEDED with supersede_reason; cascade sets roadmap/plans/execs/close in the same chain to SUPERSEDED

constraints.condition: --director-confirm must be present
constraints.error_message: intent supersede requires --director-confirm (Director authority)

gating.post_condition: chain and all downstream artifacts SUPERSEDED — permanently ineligible to become active

operations.description: Switch which chain is active (analog `git checkout <branch>`). No --director-confirm required — default-to-latest plus mandatory session bootstrap visibility are the compensating safety net. SUPERSEDED chains are permanently ineligible.

inputs.description: Chain version to activate (e.g. v2)

outputs.description: Active-chain pointer updated; Sigma/design/intent-history.md re-rendered

constraints.condition: target chain file must exist
constraints.error_message: Chain <version> not found

constraints.condition: target intent must not be SUPERSEDED
constraints.error_message: INTENT <version> is SUPERSEDED — permanently ineligible to become active again. Run: sigma intent list

gating.pre_condition: target chain exists and intent.state != SUPERSEDED
gating.post_condition: subsequent domain commands operate on the newly active chain

operations.description: View the operation history log (Sigma/logs/operations.jsonl) with optional filters. Read-only — never writes or rotates the log.

inputs.name: --status
inputs.description: Filter by result: success or error

inputs.name: --operation
inputs.description: Filter by operation name (substring match, e.g. "intent")

inputs.name: --since
inputs.description: Only entries at or after this time (ISO date, or relative: 1d, 12h, 30m)

inputs.name: --until
inputs.description: Only entries at or before this time (ISO date, or relative: 1d, 12h, 30m)

inputs.name: -n, --limit
inputs.description: Show only the last N matching entries

inputs.name: --json
inputs.description: Print raw JSONL instead of formatted log lines

outputs.description: Formatted (or raw JSONL) operation log entries matching the filters

gating.pre_condition: none — missing log file reports an empty history
